summary: Implemented slugify() in src/slugkit/slug.py using stdlib only (unicodedata NFKD + combining-mark strip, ASCII encode with 'ignore', then split on non [a-z0-9] runs and join with single hyphens). Empty/symbol-only input raises ValueError. All 6 slug tests plus the version test pass: `uv run pytest -q` -> 7 passed. No test files were modified; only src/slugkit/slug.py changed. Scoped strictly to task 1.1 per tasks.md: the 'Maximum length' requirement (truncation without trailing hyphen) is intentionally NOT implemented and the max_length parameter is accepted but currently ignored, since openspec/changes/add-slugify/tasks.md assigns it to task 1.2. No dependencies added.
